name: AI builder communities
one_line: Gathers the people building with AI in one room, and earns from sponsors who want to be in that room.
sells: Event sponsorships, partner tiers, hiring access, deal flow
customers: Sponsors (AI and cloud companies), employers, investors

revenue.note: Too new and informal to be measured. Building sits at the floor height until a sourced size exists.

structure.why: Mostly volunteer-run local groups; no measured market shares.

econ: Club goods and network effects: a room is valuable because of who else is in it, so the first group to gather the best builders in a city tends to keep them.

companies.name: The Frontier Room
companies.note: Andrew's buildout plan for a Fort Lauderdale AI builders' club.

companies.name: AI Tinkerers
companies.note: Network of local AI meetups; the Miami chapter is referenced in the Frontier Room buildout.
